response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and 20 years of development experience exceeding the 8–12 year requirement, there are critical gaps for this role. Most significantly, professional C++ experience dates back to 2014–2015 (11 years), with recent career trajectory focused entirely on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies rather than systems programming. Additionally, the candidate lacks essential expertise in industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, SDL practices), embedded systems, and industrial automation platforms. Limited robotics exposure in non-C++ stacks (2016–2018) does not compensate for these domain and technical gaps.
strengths: Extensive software development maturity (20 years) with demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring capabilities across diverse technology domains
Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures with proven ability to design and build scalable solutions
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, DevOps infrastructure, and quality-first mindset
concerns: Critical C++ expertise gap: Last significant professional C++ work was 2014–2015; recent 11 years focused entirely on TypeScript and Node.js web development
Missing industrial domain expertise: No demonstrated knowledge of industrial automation, IoT platforms, IEC 62443 standards, Secure Development Lifecycle, or embedded systems
Educational background (BS Computer Science) does not strictly meet B.E./B.Tech requirement; no MQTT protocol, Azure cloud platform, or industrial cybersecurity standards experience mentioned
